page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a woodcut ornament above the heading and an ornamental initial at the start of the paragraph. Below the text, at the left, is the gathering signature; at the right, the catchword. No margin notes. Faint mirrored text (show-through) in the margins and above the heading is left out.

main_text.l: EA est sacrarum literarum perfectio, lector
re de sacra philosophia, ea metho-
do, ut ex sacris Bibliis excerperet ea

page.notes: Show-through of the facing page (mirrored text in the right margin and above the heading, including a faint "PRÆFATIO." above the ornament) is not transcribed, so no running head is given. Spelling of "Biblijs" is read as "Bibliis" (final i printed as j). "Danæus" is a best reading of the name. The hyphen after "eruditio" is faint and was read as a line-end hyphen. The text in the first line of the page is uncertain at "possunt" and "Danæus" only.
